title: Genome-to-Image Translation: Reconstructing Escherichia coli Morphology from Genomic Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2611.31132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli is established in routine practice by culture-based susceptibility testing, which is slow relative to the clinical need for an early treatment decision. Resistance status also leaves a measurable trace in cell morphology, and whole-genome sequencing of clinical isolates is increasingly available, which raises the question of whether colony appearance can be predicted directly from an isolate's genome. We formulate this as a conditional image-generation problem. The assembled contigs of each isolate are encoded into a single 768-dimensional vector by a frozen genomic language model through a segment-contig-isolate aggregation hierarchy, and a conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty synthesizes colony images from this embedding together with the applied antibiotic and the resistance label. translated_title: 基因组到图像的翻译：从基因组序列重建大肠杆菌形态
translated_abstract: 大肠杆菌的抗菌药物耐药性在常规临床实践中是通过基于培养的药敏试验来确定的，这种方式相对于临床对早期治疗决策的需求而言速度较慢。耐药状态同时会在细胞形态中留下可测量的痕迹，而临床分离株的全基因组测序正日益普及，这引出了一个研究问题：能否直接从分离株的基因组预测其菌落外观。我们将该问题表述为一个条件图像生成问题：每个分离株的组装重叠群通过“片段-重叠群-分离株”的聚合层次结构，由一个冻结的基因组语言模型编码为单个768维向量，随后一个带梯度惩罚的条件Wasserstein GAN利用该嵌入向量以及所用抗生素和耐药标签来合成菌落图像。我们在22个临床血液分离株于阿奇霉素作用下成像所得的167,356张单细胞图像上进行训练。
tldr: 该研究提出一种条件图像生成方法，利用冻结的基因组语言模型将大肠杆菌全基因组编码为768维向量，再通过条件Wasserstein GAN结合抗生素与耐药标签直接从基因组序列生成菌落形态图像，有望加速抗菌药物耐药性的判断。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a conditional image-generation framework that encodes E. coli whole-genome sequences into a 768-dimensional vector via a frozen genomic language model and uses a conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty to synthesize colony images directly from the genome, antibiotic, and resistance label, potentially accelerating antimicrobial resistance assessment.
